title: Evening Sunwatch
text:
🌇 Evening Sunwatch — October 09, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Moderate (C1.0)
🔥 Latest solar flare: C1.4 (Peaked October 09, 2026 at 16:02 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 370 km/s (Moderate)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 1.33)
🚨 NOAA Watch: Geomagnetic Storm Category G2 Predicted

I'm still watching that earlier M1.3 flare. ☀️

A bright active region stands out near the Sun’s right limb, while the coronagraph shows no clear large outward eruption.

Image: NOAA GOES-19 SUVI — 131 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
